bullets.text: Puthur Police recovered a 21-year-old man's body floating in Puzhal Lake after a dispute over stolen bike money turned fatal, leading to four arrests by police.
Residents in Thiruvallur expressed shock after ration shops distributed rice infested with worms and weevils, and the office should monitor public distribution quality.
CMRL announced the Chennai Metro Phase 2 first stretch between Poonamallee Bypass and Vadapalani will open on October 11, and the office should track launch preparations.
Chief Minister Vijay will launch the expanded 'Vetri Payanam' free bus scheme for women covering 12,692 buses on October 2, and the office should monitor rollout details.
The Speaker, ministers, and film figures paid floral tributes to actor Sivaji Ganesan at his Adyar memorial on his birth anniversary.
The Tamil Nadu government announced Gandhi Kavalar Awards for five police officers for exceptional performance in prohibition enforcement work.
The state government plans to build free houses on land bought under the LIG scheme in Tharamani, and the office should watch project developments.
Avadi Central Crime Branch arrested a 28-year-old man for collecting 25.87 lakh rupees from nine people with fake government job appointment orders, and the office should monitor fraud cases.
Chennai Metro achieved a hat-trick by completing three tunneling works in three days, and the office should note the infrastructure milestone.
A husband filed a complaint at the SP office against the Tiruttani TVK West secretary regarding a domestic dispute involving his wife, and the office should monitor developments.
Police arrested an intoxicated man who entered an Anganwadi center in RK Pet and threatened an assistant with death, and the office should ensure center security.
Collector stated that Thiruvallur district is fully prepared to face the northeast monsoon, and the office should coordinate disaster preparedness.
U.S. Bancorp established a Global Capability Center in Chennai to serve as an India financial services hub, and the office should support technology investments.
A Policy Consensus Centre study found India's data centre expansion can coexist with residential communities through evidence-based standards, which the portfolio team should review.
Netherlands Minister Silvio Erkens stated his country can learn from how India uses smartphones, software, and AI to help farmers improve productivity.
TVK announced that Chief Minister Vijay will hold a roadshow in Madurantakam and urged no disruptions, and the office should monitor event security.
Left parties held a demonstration in Chennai Mint demanding the Chief Election Commissioner resign, prompting comments from political figures.
Minister Vanni Arasu stated firmly that VCK will not be part of any alliance that includes PMK and BJP, addressing political rumors.
